apps.localizedDescription:
Apps2Samsung installs Jellyfin and other web and community apps onto your Samsung Tizen TV — no PC, no Tizen Studio, and no manual sideloading.

This is the mobile (phone) installer head of Apps2Samsung. Put your TV into Developer Mode, point the app at it over your local network, sign in once with a free Samsung account to provision a signing certificate, and install.

Features:

* Finds Samsung Tizen TVs on your network, or connect directly by IP.
* Installs Jellyfin (multiple build variants) and a catalog of community apps.
* Give any app a custom launcher icon and a custom title.
* Optional Jellyfin server pre-configuration: server URL, auto-login, and custom CSS.
* Uses a free Samsung account certificate — no paid developer account required.

Requirements:

* A Samsung Tizen TV in Developer Mode, on the same local network as your phone.

Desktop versions for Windows, macOS and Linux are also available. Apps2Samsung is free and open source (GPL-3.0).

versions.localizedDescription:
# Apps2Samsung 3.2.1

A small follow-up to 3.2.

## ✨ Highlights

### 🔔 Beta users hear about the stable release
With beta updates on, a beta like 3.2.0-beta was never told about 3.2.0 stable, because the update check treated the two as the same version. A beta now sees the stable release of its own number as an update. (#1055)

### 🏷️ Categories come from the community catalog
The categories in the catalog, their order, names and tile colours now come from the community catalog itself, so a new category shows up without waiting for an Apps2Samsung release. Apps without a category of their own stay under **Other**. (#1054, #1056)

## What changed

### 🚀 New features
- feat(catalog): categories, order, names and tile colours from the community catalog (#1054) (#1056)
### 🐛 Bug fixes
- fix(update): offer the stable release to a beta of the same version (#1055)
### 🧰 Maintenance & CI
- chore: version 3.2.1 (#1057)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Apps2Samsung/Apps2Samsung/compare/v3.2.0...v3.2.1

---

### 🛡️ Security Notice
Antivirus warnings may occur and are likely **false positives**.
